review.notes: All 29 bilingual entries read in full. Four native generic reply segments remain independently composable with leading spaces and identical emotion/line tokens. Wizard formality, Haley gender alternatives, Sam alternatives and emoticon, and Maru invention context retained. Speaker names checked against locked glossary. Greek thanks idiom uses χίλια ευχαριστώ for thanks a million.
